extName.message: Free Game Claimer: Epic, Steam, GOG, Prime
extName.description: Extension name in the browser's extension list and on the store pages. At most 45 characters (addons.mozilla.org limit). Keep "Free Game Claimer" and the store names in English.

extDescription.message: Automatically claim free games from Epic Games Store, Steam, GOG, IndieGala and Prime Gaming. Just stay signed in.
extDescription.description: Short description in the browser's extension list and on the store pages. At most 132 characters (Chrome Web Store limit). Keep the store names in English.

extActionTitle.description: Tooltip on the extension's toolbar button. The product name: keep it in English.

catalogLocale.description: Not shown. Set it to this file's folder name (for example de or pt_BR): it picks the plural rules for counts such as "3 games claimed".

headerClaimedCount_one.description: Popup header, under the extension name: how many games it has claimed so far. Form for counts your language treats as singular.

headerClaimedCount_other.description: Popup header, under the extension name: how many games it has claimed so far. Form for all other counts.

headerClaimingStatus.description: Popup header, after the claimed count ("47 games claimed · Claiming…") while a claim run is going on.

sponsorPill.description: Small pill-shaped link after a heart in the popup header's right corner; opens GitHub Sponsors. About 10 characters fit.

sponsorPillTooltip.message: Sponsor from $$5/month and get your name in the README
sponsorPillTooltip.description: Tooltip on the header's Sponsor link. Write $$ for a dollar sign: $$5 shows as $5.

tabsLabel.description: Screen-reader name for the two tabs at the top of the popup (Settings, Free Games).

settingsTab.description: First of the two tabs at the top of the popup. Each tab gets half of the popup's 360 px width.

freeGamesTab.description: Second of the two tabs at the top of the popup: the games that are free now. Each tab gets half of the popup's 360 px width.

autoClaimSwitch.description: Settings: label of the on/off switch for scheduled checks. Shares a row with the Claim now button.

autoClaimPaused.description: Settings: shown after the Auto-claim switch while it is off, as "· paused".

claimNowButton.description: Button that checks every store and claims what's free right away. Shares a row with the Auto-claim switch and doesn't wrap: keep it short.

claimNowButtonBusy.description: The Claim now button's label while a claim run is going on (the button is disabled). Keep it short.

scheduleCheckLabel.description: Settings: label before the dropdown for how often the stores are checked. The row reads "Check [Once a day] at [Any time]"; each label names the dropdown after it.

scheduleAtLabel.description: Settings: label before the time-of-day dropdown, shown only for "Once a day". The row reads "Check [Once a day] at [Any time]".

scheduleHourTooltip.message: The day's check waits for this hour; if the browser is closed then, it runs when you next open it that day.

scheduleAnyTime.description: First option of the time-of-day dropdown: no set hour. The other options are clock times.

frequencyBrowserStart.description: Option of the how-often dropdown: check each time the browser starts.

frequencyDaily.description: Option of the how-often dropdown (the default).

storesLabel.description: Screen-reader name for the list of stores in Settings.

loginLoggedIn.description: Settings, at the right end of a store's row: the user is signed in to that store. Shares the row with the store name and doesn't wrap: keep it short.

loginLoggedInTooltip.message: Signed in as of the last claim run

loginLogIn.description: Settings, at the right end of a store's row: link to the store's sign-in page. Shares the row with the store name and doesn't wrap: keep it short.

loginSignedOutTooltip.message: Not signed in as of the last claim run — free games can't be claimed. Click to log in.
loginSignedOutTooltip.description: Tooltip on "Log in" when the last check found the user signed out.

loginUncheckedTooltip.message: Not checked yet — click to log in.
loginUncheckedTooltip.description: Tooltip on "Log in" before any check has run.

primeNoMembership.description: Settings, at the right end of the Prime Gaming row, in place of "Logged in": the Amazon account has no Prime membership. Prime is Amazon's product name. Doesn't wrap: keep it short.

primeNoMembershipTooltip.message: Signed in, but this Amazon account has no Prime membership, so Prime Gaming offers can't be claimed.

healthNetwork.description: Settings: warning after a ⚠ sign on a store's row: the store didn't answer. Shares the row with the store name and "Logged in" and doesn't wrap: keep it short.

healthChanged.description: Settings: warning after a ⚠ sign on a store's row: the store's site changed and the extension needs an update. Links to the issue tracker. Doesn't wrap: keep it short.

healthCaptcha.description: Settings: warning after a ⚠ sign on a store's row: a claim is waiting for the user to solve a captcha. Doesn't wrap: keep it short.

healthUnfinished.description: Settings: warning after a ⚠ sign on a store's row: a claim didn't get to the end (it is retried). Doesn't wrap: keep it short.

healthTooltip.description: Tooltip on a store's warning: what went wrong, then when.

detail.example: Epic's checkout didn't finish; it's retried tomorrow

healthChangedTooltip.message: $DETAIL$ ($TIME$). The extension needs an update; click to report it.
healthChangedTooltip.description: Tooltip on the "Store changed" warning, which links to the issue tracker: what went wrong, when, and what to do.

detail.example: Steam's search page has no result list

healthEpicGetButtonMissing.message: Couldn't find the "Get" button on a free game's page
healthEpicGetButtonMissing.description: Tooltip on Epic's "Store changed" warning: what went wrong. "Get" is the label of Epic's own button; use the label Epic's store shows in your language.

healthEpicCheckoutUnfinished.message: Epic's checkout didn't finish; it's retried tomorrow
healthEpicCheckoutUnfinished.description: Tooltip on Epic's "Claim unfinished" warning: what went wrong.

healthEpicCaptcha.message: Epic wants a captcha solved in its open tab to finish a claim
healthEpicCaptcha.description: Tooltip on Epic's "Needs captcha" warning: what the user has to do.

steamMinRatingLabel.description: Settings, under Steam: label before the dropdown for the lowest review score a free Steam game needs to be claimed.

steamMinRatingTooltip.message: Skip free Steam games whose reviews are less positive than this.
steamMinRatingTooltip.description: Tooltip on the Min. rating dropdown.

steamMinRatingAny.description: First option of the Min. rating dropdown: claim every free Steam game, whatever its reviews.

steamMinRatingOption.description: Option of the Min. rating dropdown: this share of positive reviews or more, then Steam's name for that score.

steamMinRatingCustom.description: Option of the Min. rating dropdown for a value an older version stored that matches none of the presets.

steamRatingVeryPositive.description: Steam's name for a review score, in the Min. rating dropdown. Use the wording Steam's store shows in your language.

steamRatingMostlyPositive.description: Steam's name for a review score, in the Min. rating dropdown. Use the wording Steam's store shows in your language.

steamRatingMixed.description: Steam's name for a review score, in the Min. rating dropdown. Use the wording Steam's store shows in your language.

steamRatingMostlyNegative.description: Steam's name for a review score, in the Min. rating dropdown. Use the wording Steam's store shows in your language.

indieGalaWheel.description: Settings, under IndieGala: checkbox to spin IndieGala's daily prize wheel. Use the name IndieGala's site gives it in your language, if it has one.

indieGalaLastPrize.description: Settings, under IndieGala: what the last wheel spin won, and when. The prize text comes from IndieGala's page.

indieGalaSteamKeyActivated.description: Settings, under IndieGala: a Steam key won on the wheel was activated on the user's Steam account.

indieGalaSteamKeyOwned.description: Settings, under IndieGala: a Steam key won on the wheel was for a game already on the user's Steam account.

primeRegionalAccess.message: Amazon sends you to $HOST$. $BUTTON$ so Prime Gaming games can be claimed there.
primeRegionalAccess.description: Settings, under Prime Gaming: Amazon sends this user to their country's Prime Gaming site, which the extension needs permission for. $BUTTON$ is a button labelled with primeRegionalAccessButton: put it where the sentence needs it.

primeRegionalAccessButton.description: Button inside the primeRegionalAccess sentence: asks the browser for permission to the country's Prime Gaming site.

primeClaimOffersFor.description: Settings, under Prime Gaming: heading of the checkboxes for the stores a Prime Gaming offer can go to (Amazon Games, Epic, GOG, Microsoft Store, Legacy Games).

primePickAtLeastOne.message: Pick at least one, or nothing is claimed.
primePickAtLeastOne.description: Warning under those checkboxes while all of them are off.

legacyEmailLabel.description: Settings, under Prime Gaming: label of an email field. Legacy Games is a store: keep its name in English.

legacyEmailPlaceholder.description: Example address shown in the empty Legacy Games email field.

legacyEmailInvalid.message: Not a valid email: codes are filled in for you to finish.
legacyEmailInvalid.description: Under the Legacy Games email field while its text isn't an email address.

legacyEmailHint.message: Codes go to this email (no newsletter). Leave empty to finish each one yourself.
legacyEmailHint.description: Under the Legacy Games email field: what the address is used for.

gamesEmpty.description: Free Games tab, when no store has a free game.

gamesFilterEmpty.description: Free Games tab, when the store filter hides every game.

platformFilterLabel.description: Screen-reader name for the row of store buttons that filter the Free Games tab.

upcomingFilter.description: Free Games tab: small toggle at the end of the store filter row that also lists games that become free soon. About 10 characters fit on the row.

upcomingFilterTooltip.message: Show games that become free soon

gameUpcoming.description: On a game in the Free Games tab: it becomes free later. Followed by its dates, as "Upcoming · Nov 13 – Nov 20".

gameClaimedPrime.description: On a Prime Gaming game in the Free Games tab, after a ✓: Amazon counts it as claimed (a code may still need redeeming).

gameInLibrary.description: On a game in the Free Games tab, after a ✓: the game is already on the user's account.

gameFreeUntil.description: On a game in the Free Games tab: the last day it is free.

gameFreeFrom.description: On an upcoming game in the Free Games tab whose end date isn't known: the day it becomes free.

gameDateRange.description: On an upcoming game in the Free Games tab: the days it is free, first to last.

pendingTitle.description: Free Games tab: heading of the list of codes and keys the extension couldn't redeem by itself.

pendingStore.description: In that list, after a game's title: the store the code is for.

pendingCopy.description: Small button next to a code that copies it. Shares the row with the code and two other buttons: keep it short.

pendingCopied.description: The Copy button's label for a moment after it copied. Keep it short.

pendingActivate.description: Small link next to a Steam key: opens Steam's activation page. Shares the row: keep it short.

pendingTryAgain.description: Small link next to a code: opens the store's redeem page to try again. Shares the row: keep it short.

pendingDismiss.description: Screen-reader name of the × button that removes an entry from the list.

pendingReasonSteamInvalid.message: Steam says the key isn't valid
pendingReasonSteamInvalid.description: In the Needs manual redeem list, under a Steam key: why Steam didn't activate it.

pendingReasonSteamUsed.message: Steam says another account already used this key
pendingReasonSteamUsed.description: In the Needs manual redeem list, under a Steam key: why Steam didn't activate it.

pendingReasonSteamRateLimited.message: Steam wants a break after too many activations; try again later
pendingReasonSteamRateLimited.description: In the Needs manual redeem list, under a Steam key: why Steam didn't activate it.

pendingReasonSteamRegion.message: Steam says this game isn't sold in your country
pendingReasonSteamRegion.description: In the Needs manual redeem list, under a Steam key: why Steam didn't activate it.

pendingReasonSteamNeedsBaseGame.message: Steam says this needs another game first
pendingReasonSteamNeedsBaseGame.description: In the Needs manual redeem list, under a Steam key: Steam wants the base game on the account first (the key is for a DLC).

pendingReasonSteamSignedOut.message: Sign in to Steam, then activate it
pendingReasonSteamSignedOut.description: In the Needs manual redeem list, under a Steam key: the user wasn't signed in to Steam. Next to it is an Activate link.

pendingReasonSteamFailed.description: In the Needs manual redeem list, under a Steam key: Steam refused for another reason, or didn't answer.

pendingReasonSteamUnfinished.description: In the Needs manual redeem list, under a Steam key: the Steam page that activates it closed before it reported back.

pendingReasonGiftNotShown.message: Won on the wheel; its gift didn't show up in G. Giveaway yet
pendingReasonGiftNotShown.description: In the Needs manual redeem list: a Steam key won on IndieGala's wheel isn't in the user's IndieGala library yet. "G. Giveaway" is the name of a tab in that library: keep it as IndieGala shows it.

pendingReasonGiftPageNotOpened.description: In the Needs manual redeem list: the IndieGala page with a won key didn't open.

pendingReasonGiftNoKey.message: The gift page showed no key
pendingReasonGiftNoKey.description: In the Needs manual redeem list: the IndieGala page with a won prize showed no key.

pendingReasonNotSteamKey.message: Not a Steam key; redeem it where IndieGala says
pendingReasonNotSteamKey.description: In the Needs manual redeem list, under a key won on IndieGala that is for another store.

pendingReasonKeyNotShown.description: In the Needs manual redeem list: IndieGala's page didn't show a won key.

pendingIndieGalaKeyNotRead.message: Key wasn't read; it's on IndieGala.
pendingIndieGalaKeyNotRead.description: In the list, in place of a key the extension couldn't read: it is still on IndieGala's page.

pendingOpenOnIndieGala.description: Small link that opens that IndieGala page. Shares the row: keep it short.

pendingAmazonCodeNotRead.message: Code wasn't read; it's on Amazon's page.
pendingAmazonCodeNotRead.description: In the list, in place of a code the extension couldn't read: it is still on Amazon's page.

pendingOpenOnAmazon.description: Small link that opens that Amazon page. Shares the row: keep it short.

reviewPromptTitle.description: Heading of a card above the tabs that asks for a store rating. Keep "Free Game Claimer" in English.

reviewPromptBody_one.message: It has claimed $COUNT$ game for you. A quick rating helps other players find it.
reviewPromptBody_one.description: Text of the rating card. "It" is the extension. Form for counts your language treats as singular.

reviewPromptBody_other.message: It has claimed $COUNT$ games for you. A quick rating helps other players find it.
reviewPromptBody_other.description: Text of the rating card. "It" is the extension. Form for all other counts.

reviewPromptRate.description: Button on the rating card that opens the store's review page. Shares a row with two other actions.

promptNotNow.description: Button on the rating card and on the sponsor card that hides the card.

reviewPromptReport.description: Link at the end of the rating card's button row; opens the issue tracker. Shares the row with two buttons and doesn't wrap: keep it short.

sponsorCardTitle_one.message: It has claimed $COUNT$ game for you
sponsorCardTitle_one.description: Heading of a thank-you card that asks for sponsorship, shown after 20 or more claims. "It" is the extension; the number is in bold. Form for counts your language treats as singular.

sponsorCardTitle_other.message: It has claimed $COUNT$ games for you
sponsorCardTitle_other.description: Heading of a thank-you card that asks for sponsorship, shown after 20 or more claims. "It" is the extension; the number is in bold. Form for all other counts.

sponsorCardBody.message: Free and built in my spare time. Sponsoring keeps it working when stores change.
sponsorCardBody.description: Text of the sponsor card. "my" is the developer; "it" is the extension.

sponsorCardButton.description: Main button of the sponsor card, after a heart; opens GitHub Sponsors. Doesn't wrap. Write $$ for a dollar sign: $$2 shows as $2.

sponsorCardButtonTooltip.description: Tooltip on the sponsor card's main button.

footerContact.description: Link at the bottom of the popup, between GitHub and Donate.

footerDonate.description: Link at the bottom of the popup, after GitHub and Contact.

badgeUpdated.description: Text on the toolbar button's badge after the extension updates. At most 4 characters: the badge cuts off the rest.
